package rulefixtures

import (
	"os"
)

// scenario for defer_in_tight_loop: `defer` statements inside loops with > 100 iterations or visible hot-path markers
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: warning.
func scenario476Positive(paths []string) error {
	for _, path := range paths {
		file, err := os.Open(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer file.Close()

		_, err = file.Read(make([]byte, 1024))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
